name: dsh-feishu-beacon
description: DSH plugin that pushes agent progress and human-attention events to a Feishu (Lark) custom-bot webhook
author: dsh-feishu-beacon contributors

scripts.test: node test/no-cjk.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs

//devDependencies: Test-time resolution set only. The host half imports @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools and @deepseek-ai/schemastery; a dsh profile provides them in production, and a checkout reaches them through a node_modules/@deepseek-ai junction. CI has neither, so the three published packages are installed here and nothing else. They are pinned to the dsh release this plugin was verified against: dsh is a developer preview with breaking changes between releases.
